title: Posh condo with city skyline views. Sleeps 4!
description:
Stay in a posh condo appointed with all the amenities and comforts of home. Wake-up feeling refreshed from sleeping on luxury linens. Slip into a plush robe and slippers. Make a fresh cup of joe with the Keurig machine. Enjoy a cozy towel from the towel warmer in the bathroom. 
 Located just 2 miles from downtown. A drive will have you in the middle of the action, or stay in and enjoy a meal on the balcony with a view of the Nashville skyline.

The space
The upscale décor and amenities will make you feel right at home. This posh one-bedroom condo located in a newly constructed building is located close to Vanderbilt University, Vanderbilt Medical Center, Centennial Park, Music Row and so much more! A 10 minute or less drive from any downtown activity or venue. 

This spacious condo is perfect for a weekend escape or business travel. 

The well equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances has everything you need to prepare a meal and enjoy dinner in. The bar seats four and the main living area offers an inviting space with Wifi and a smart TV. 

The large bathroom offers a shower/tub combo. A heated towel bar provides warming, so you will never have to use a cold towel. Make-up wash clothes are also available for your convenience. Plush robes and slippers are available for guests. 

The spacious bedroom is well appointed with luxury linens, a stunning chandelier with retractable ceiling fan and remote control. The smart TV is available for streaming your favorite entertainment channel. A sound machine will ensure a peaceful night of sleep. The full length mirror will make it easy to be ready for your evening out. 

A hide-away sofa will provide a second bed with luxury linens and multiple pillow options for sleeping comfort. 

Enjoy the balcony with skyline views from comfort of patio chairs and small table for enjoying morning coffee or a cocktail.

There is a dedicated parking space for guests to park.

Guest access
Guests can enjoy the entire condo.

Other things to note
As your hostess I hope you feel at home in this condo and treat it with the care and respect you would treat your own home.

Guests staying longer than one weeks will incur an additional cleaning charge of $65 for each additional two weeks. This is not reflected in the cost and will be added on.
